name: Welcome To Ponyville
source: “Welcome to Ponyville” is a story based adventure (visual novel) game. Taking place directly after Season 2, the game features a multitude of jobs to perform, a furnishable home, two main intertwining storylines, a plethora of sub-stories, and over 50 characters to interact with. You, the player, will often get to make decisions that directly influence not only the characters within the game, but even Equestria as a whole. Utilizing a custom built engine, “Welcome to Ponyville” should never be the same game twice. So, what are you waiting for? Grab your luggage, head to the train station, and hop on the first available train to Ponyville; a magical world filled with candy colored ponies, friendship, romance, and adventure. After all, nothing dark or scary ever happens in Ponyville... Right?
translation:
《欢迎来到小马谷》是一款以故事为基础的冒险游戏（视觉小说）。故事紧接第二季之后展开，游戏包含许多可完成的工作、一座可以布置的房屋、两条相互交织的主线、数量众多的支线故事，以及50多名可以互动的角色。

玩家经常需要做出决定，这些决定不仅会直接影响游戏中的角色，甚至会影响整个小马国。

游戏使用自制引擎，因此《欢迎来到小马谷》不会出现两次完全相同的游玩体验。

你还在等什么？带上行李，前往火车站，乘坐第一班前往小马谷的列车吧。那里是一个充满糖果色小马、友谊、爱情与冒险的魔法世界。

毕竟，小马谷从来不会发生任何黑暗或可怕的事情……对吧？
